about: Channel gate, run on each repurposed piece (carousel, video script, newsletter). Ask the four C questions plus the ones marked for that channel. State: a header with the voice in three lines and the source article, then the one piece.

C1.instructions: Every number and claim in the piece also appears in the source article given in the header.

C2.instructions: The opening states a specific claim, number or question from the source article.

C3.instructions: The piece has one call to action.

C4.instructions: The piece reads like the voice described in the header.

K1.instructions: Carousel only: each slide carries one idea.

K2.instructions: Carousel only: the caption adds context that is not on the slides.

V1.instructions: Video only: the script opens on the claim or the result, with no greeting.

V2.instructions: Video only: the ending answers what the opening raised.

N1.instructions: Newsletter only: the edition gives the reader one useful idea without clicking through.

N2.instructions: Newsletter only: the subject line says what is inside the edition.

code_checks.em_dash: Fails if the piece contains an em dash (U+2014).
code_checks.avoided_words: Fails if the piece contains a word or phrase from the avoid list in brand-and-voice.md.
code_checks.slide_length: Carousel only: fails if a slide has more than 40 words.
code_checks.subject_length: Newsletter only: fails if a subject line is over 60 characters.
